# TipeeeStream triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to TipeeeStream. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to TipeeeStream. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.disconnected`</small>

## Donation

Runs when someone donates through TipeeeStream. Great for a thank-you message or an alert.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who donated |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | The message they wrote |
| `%fees%` | The fee TipeeeStream took |
| `%avatar%` | Their picture (web link) |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.donation`</small>

## Relayed cheer

Runs when TipeeeStream passes on someone cheering bits. Only runs if you tick the "Also publish..." box for TipeeeStream on the Donations page (off by default, because your streaming site already reports it).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum bits** | Only run when at least this many bits were cheered. Leave 0 for any amount. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who cheered |
| `%bits%` | How many bits |
| `%message%` | Their message |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.cheer`</small>

## Relayed follow

Runs when TipeeeStream passes on a new follower. Only runs if you tick the "Also publish..." box for TipeeeStream on the Donations page (off by default, because your streaming site already reports it).

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The new follower |
| `%platform%` | Where they followed |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.follow`</small>

## Relayed host

Runs when TipeeeStream passes on another streamer hosting you. Only runs if you tick the "Also publish..." box for TipeeeStream on the Donations page (off by default, because your streaming site already reports it).

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who is hosting you |
| `%viewers%` | How many viewers they brought |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.host`</small>

## Relayed raid

Runs when TipeeeStream passes on a raid. Only runs if you tick the "Also publish..." box for TipeeeStream on the Donations page (off by default, because your streaming site already reports it).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum viewers** | Only run when at least this many viewers came along. Leave 0 for any number. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who raided you |
| `%viewers%` | How many viewers they brought |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.raid`</small>

## Relayed subscription

Runs when TipeeeStream passes on a new or returning subscriber. Only runs if you tick the "Also publish..." box for TipeeeStream on the Donations page (off by default, because your streaming site already reports it).

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who subscribed |
| `%months%` | How many months |
| `%message%` | Their message |

<small>Type id: `tipeeestream.subscription`</small>
